source.name: Chicago Bulls (nba.com)
source.quote: The Chicago Bulls announced a multiyear relationship with Chicago-based tech-giant Motorola Mobility, a Lenovo company, making it the Official Jersey Patch Partner of the Chicago Bulls.
source.note: Announced 20 September 2022 for the 2022-23 preseason; the release does not restate the 2026-27 season.
